visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a group of male police officers in dark blue uniforms walking down a steep, rocky, and leaf-strewn forest path. The lead officer, wearing a tactical vest and a cap, looks towards the camera and gestures with his hands while speaking. The background consists of dense green foliage and tall trees under bright, natural daylight. (2) A quick cut reveals a wider view of a rocky riverbed area where a makeshift shelter has been found. The shelter is constructed from blue and white striped plastic tarp and green netting, anchored to the surrounding trees. Several officers are seen gathering around the structure, inspecting its base and the surrounding ground. (3) The camera focuses on the officers as they meticulously search the area. One officer bends down to pick up a dark metal cooking pot from the rocky ground, while others lift and inspect large black plastic bags hidden under the tarp. The lighting remains consistent as they move through the shaded forest area near the running water of a small stream.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, rhythmic pop music featuring a strong electronic beat. A male voice speaks with high energy and clarity, discussing a received report about illegal poaching. (2) A 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition as the group moves. The background music continues while the sounds of leaves crunching under footsteps are faintly audible. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound effect occurs when they spot the shelter. The voices shift to a more conversational and investigative tone, still high in arousal. (4) As an officer picks up a metal pot, a subtle metallic clinking sound is heard. This is followed by the distinct rustling of plastic as bags are opened and inspected. (5) The music swells slightly in volume as the main speaker provides a concluding remark, noting the absence of illegal evidence like chainsaws, ending with a satisfied and resolved vocal tone.
